elements.char: Here we have described LonGP, a non-parametric additive GP
elements.label: text

elements.char: model for longitudinal data analysis, which we demonstrate to
elements.label: text

elements.char: solve many of the commonly faced modelling challenges. As
elements.label: text

elements.char: LonGP builds on GP regression, it can automatically handle

elements.char: Missing values are also easily accounted for via bi mask kernels
elements.label: text

elements.char: without any extra effort. More generally, LonGP provides a
elements.label: text

elements.char: exible framework to choose appropriate covariance structures
elements.label: text

elements.char: for the correlated outcomes via the GP kernel functions, and the
elements.label: text

elements.char: chosen kernels are properly adjusted to the given data by carrying
elements.label: text

elements.char: out Bayesian inference for the kernel parameters. GP are known
elements.label: text

elements.char: to be capable of approximating any continuous function. Thus,
elements.label: text

elements.char: LonGP is applicable to any longitudinal data set. Furthermore,
